scope: S07 numerical/field producer contracts and S07-phase T05 registration; software verification only. No native-CAD, physical, certificate or release qualification.

hashing.structured: S01 scientific_hash = SHA256(canonical_wire) of descriptor / model / phase objects
hashing.solver_descriptors: solve_dolfinx content_sha256 = sha256 of sorted-key compact JSON (labelled per descriptor)

tolerances.existing_theory_gate: max_err_pct 5, strict < at gate levels, level match |a - b| < 1e-9
tolerances.frozen: before execution; never relaxed after a failure

observables.producer: fem_solid.solve_dolfinx.elastic_stress (UFL sig(u) of the P<order> displacement)

descriptor.evaluation: pointwise UFL expression; transforms as Q sigma Q^T under a proper rotation

descriptor.input: scalar DG1 field bound by validate_observable_contract and geometry_vertex_association
descriptor.reduction: max over incident cells at each topological vertex

descriptor.input: scalar DG1 field bound by validate_observable_contract and geometry_vertex_association
descriptor.reduction: arithmetic mean of incident-cell scalar samples
descriptor.weights: unweighted; not volume-weighted, not tensor-first, not L2

descriptor.reduction: arithmetic mean of the four reference-vertex VM samples of a cell
descriptor.applicability: incomplete: historical rounded MPa/SF keep legacy identities; not relabelled, sharpened or qualified

descriptor.evaluation: VM of the stress tensor at the physical cell centroid

descriptor.definition: sum_i (f_i - g_i)^2 / sum_i g_i^2 over all DG coefficients

observables.producer: fem.assemble_scalar(form(inner(d, d) * dx)) / fem.assemble_scalar(form(inner(g, g) * dx))

descriptor.definition: integral of the squared field difference over the domain / integral of the squared baseline
descriptor.independent_oracle: element mass matrix diag V/10, off-diagonal V/20 for P1 on a tetrahedron

models.emitted_only_after: realized_solver_contract reads ksp_type cg, pc_type gamg, rtol, atol 1e-50, divtol 1e4, max_it from PETSc
models.mesh: serial connected tet4/tet10 with positive sampled Jacobians

models.producer: crates/physics/src/fine.rs Plate (DKT bending + CST membrane, direct Cholesky)

models.note: display/tier label only; ambiguous between plate certification and solid reference; never an observable or model identity

s07_phase.policy: build with assurance.testing.catalog.bind_policy(cases, limits); publish with assurance.testing.receipt.publish_receipt (no-clobber)
s07_phase.not_global_T05: S08 owns T05-09..12 primary bindings; the root combines phase receipts after S08. Never resolve this phase and an S08 phase with the same IDs in one inventory.
s07_phase.row_rule: every listed row/provider is mandatory and maps by polarity into its bucket's schema control; missing/error/not_run fails the bucket; a bucket label never grants a row PASS
